nodes.name: Scraper Webhook
nodes.notes:
Receives POST from Python scraper.
Payload: JSON array of lead objects.
Configure scraper env: WEBHOOK_URL=https://[your-n8n-domain]/webhook/scraper-leads

parameters.query:
-- Check if this is a returning lead and whether it's day or night.
-- Uses LEFT JOIN to ensure is_daytime() always executes even if no returning lead.
WITH time_ctx AS (
  SELECT is_daytime() AS is_day, current_shift() AS current_shift
),
returning AS (
  SELECT * FROM find_returning_lead($1, $2, $3) LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  r.conversation_id AS existing_conv_id,
  r.assigned_agent_id,
  r.current_property AS existing_property,
  r.same_property,
  r.mode AS existing_mode,
  t.is_day,
  t.current_shift
FROM time_ctx t
LEFT JOIN returning r ON TRUE;

-- Returning lead, same property: update last_message_at on existing conversation.
UPDATE conversations
SET last_message_at = NOW()
WHERE conversation_id = $1::uuid
RETURNING conversation_id, assigned_agent_id, lead_name;

-- Get the assigned agent's WhatsApp number.
SELECT whatsapp_number FROM agents WHERE agent_id = $1;

-- Create new conversation for scraper lead (day mode).
INSERT INTO conversations (lead_phone, lead_name, lead_email, current_property, mode, source, arrived_during)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'pending_assignment', $5, 'day')
RETURNING conversation_id, lead_phone, lead_name, current_property, mode;

INSERT INTO properties_cache (property_id, payload)
VALUES ($1, $2::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (property_id) DO UPDATE
  SET payload = EXCLUDED.payload, fetched_at = NOW();

nodes.name: Call WF12: Owner Resolver
nodes.notes:
Resolves owner agent from EasyBroker tags.
Input: { property_public_id, conversation_id } (passthrough).
Output: { owner_agent_id, owner_name, owner_number, resolved }.
Set env WF12_WORKFLOW_ID to the imported WF12 id (w7yJr7naWoxPq6Pw).

nodes.name: Call WF13: Owner Notify
nodes.notes:
NIVEL owner. Creates a 2-min owner-scoped auction and DMs the owner a
TOMO claim code (owner claims via WF3b). On no-claim, WF3c escalates to
the guard auction. Set env WF13_WORKFLOW_ID to the imported WF13 id.

parameters.query:
-- Owner unresolvable (no tag / lookup failed / agent w/o WhatsApp):
-- route directly to the manager tier.
UPDATE conversations
SET routing_tier = 'manager', tier_notified_at = NOW()
WHERE conversation_id = $1::uuid
RETURNING conversation_id;

-- Create new conversation for scraper lead (night mode).
INSERT INTO conversations (lead_phone, lead_name, lead_email, current_property, mode, source, arrived_during)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'night_queued', $5, 'night')
RETURNING conversation_id, lead_phone, lead_name, current_property;
